identificationModule.briefTitle: Paclitaxel, Cisplatin, and Radiation Therapy With or Without Cetuximab in Treating Patients With Locally Advanced Esophageal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Trial Evaluating the Addition of Cetuximab to Paclitaxel, Cisplatin, and Radiation for Patients With Esophageal Cancer Who Are Treated Without Surgery

armGroups.label: Chemoradiation + Cetuximab
armGroups.description: External beam radiation therapy (RT) with concurrent weekly paclitaxel, cisplatin, and cetuximab

armGroups.label: Chemoradiation
armGroups.description: External beam radiation therapy with concurrent weekly paclitaxel, and cisplatin

interventions.name: cetuximab
interventions.description: Weekly with external beam radiation therapy for a total of six doses. The initial dose of cetuximab is 400 mg/m\^2 intravenously administered over 120 minutes on day 1, followed by weekly infusions of 250 mg/m\^2 intravenously over 60 minutes on days 8, 15, 22, 29, and 36. The infusion rate of cetuximab must never exceed 5 mL/min.

interventions.name: cisplatin
interventions.description: Weekly with external beam radiation therapy for a total of six doses. Patients receive 25 mg/m\^2 as an intravenous infusion over 30-60 minutes on days 1, 8, 15, 22, 29 and 36.

interventions.name: paclitaxel
interventions.description: Weekly with external beam radiation therapy for a total of six doses. Patients receive 50 mg/m\^2 as an intravenous infusion over 1 hour on days 1, 8, 15, 22, 29 and 36.

interventions.name: radiation therapy
interventions.description: 1.8 Gy daily for 28 days (over 5-6 weeks) for a total dose of 50.4 Gy.
